summary: Independent frontend-only verification of /construction.html (static vanilla HTML/CSS/JS + GSAP ScrollTrigger + Three.js) against the rebuilt ORIGINAL pinned-stage architecture. Executed 5 Playwright suites: (1) hero geometry + horizontal-overflow + console-error sweep across 13 viewports; (2) Structural System 6-state forward/reverse sweep (30 samples each way) with settled per-state measurement of expanded description height, clipping, header clearance and SVG group sync; (3) Seismic (5), Reinforcement (6), Waterproofing (5) forward/reverse sweeps at 1920x1080 and 1366x768 including trailing regulatory note visibility; (4) Ground depth readout correctness at 41 scroll samples + inter-panel gap measurement, plus Concrete (7 cards) and Execution Control (5 columns) horizontal rails forward/reverse; (5) fast scrollbar-jump determinism (12 jumps) and resize across 1440x900/1280x800/1024x768/768x1024/1920x1080; plus tablet/mobile flow-fallback audit at 768x1024, 430x932, 390x844, 1024x768. Result: all locked-text, state-sequence, overflow and fallback requirements verified as PASSING. Zero console/page errors. No text found cut, hidden behind the header, or unreachable at any tested desktop viewport. No application code was modified.

issues: COSMETIC/INFORMATIONAL ONLY - not a functional failure: the hero kicker 'NOVA KONUT - METHODOLOGY' top edge measures 6-20px above the fixed header element's bounding-box bottom (e.g. 1024x768 kicker top=130 vs header bottom=150; 375x812 kicker top=106 vs header bottom=121). Screenshot verification confirms the header is in its transparent state at scrollY=0 with no painted background over that band, so the kicker is fully legible and NOT visually obscured. Desktop targets in scope (1920x1080, 1440x900, 1366x768, 1280x800, 1280x720) have full header clearance. Optional hardening: add a few px of hero top padding below 1200px so the kicker never enters the header box even if the header ever gains an opaque background at scroll top.

design_issues.screen: Pinned copy windows at reduced heights (e.g. Waterproofing / Seismic at 1366x768)
issues: EXPECTED BEHAVIOUR OF THE APPROVED DESIGN, logged for awareness only: when the approved copy is taller than the column, .cx-copywin gains .is-tracking and .cx-copymove translates so the canonical active state stays in view. Consequence is that at the LAST state the section intro paragraph's first line(s) sit above the clip window, and at states 1-4 the trailing regulatory note sits below it. Verified that the intro is fully readable at state 01 and the trailing regulatory note is fully readable inside the window at the final state in every tracked section, so all locked text remains reachable by scrolling - requirement satisfied, no fix required.

critical_code_review_comments: construction.js stateDriver() uses Math.floor(self.progress * n * 1.02) so at progress exactly 0 no item is active until the first onUpdate tick fires; measured behaviour showed idx=-1 (zero active states) only at the exact pin start of Structural/Seismic/Reinforcement/Waterproofing/Execution. State 01 activates immediately on the first pixel of scroll, so it is not user-visible, but seeding items[0].classList.add('is-on') at init would make the very first painted frame of each pinned stage deterministic. Concrete already behaves this way (fwd sequence started at 0).

copyTracker() only re-measures on ScrollTrigger 'refreshInit'. Verified correct across all resizes tested, but note it depends on ScrollTrigger's resize refresh firing; a ResizeObserver on .cx-copywin would make the content-aware geometry robust against font-swap/late-webfont reflow that does not trigger a ScrollTrigger refresh.

The Concrete section heading measures right=3611px at 1920 wide because it lives inside the horizontal rail container. Text renders correctly inside the viewport and documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth, so there is no real overflow - but a heading whose box extends 1700px past the viewport is fragile; consider taking the section head out of the translated rail wrapper.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 is obsolete; THIS iteration (21) is the current baseline for /construction.html. Detailed verified results: HERO - fully visible and clear of the fixed header (header bottom=150 at >=1280 widths, 121 at <=1024) at 1920x1080, 1680x1050, 1440x900, 1366x768, 1280x800, 1280x720; kicker, H1, claim line, both left paragraphs, all three right paragraphs and the 'SCROLL TO INSPECT THE STRUCTURE' cue all measured inside the safe area with zero element-level clipping. OVERFLOW - documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth === 0 at all 13 tested viewports (1920x1080, 1680x1050, 1440x900, 1366x768, 1280x800, 1280x720, 1024x1366, 1024x768, 768x1024, 430x932, 393x852, 390x844, 375x812). CONSOLE - zero console errors and zero pageerrors in every run. STRUCTURAL (cx-section-structural) - forward sequence [0,1,2,3,4,5] and reverse [5,4,3,2,1,0], exactly one .cx-el.is-on at all times, .cx-gr[data-el].is-on always equals the text index (no mismatch across 60 samples); settled per-state measurement showed descClip=0 with maxHeight equal to scrollHeight (120-140px) for all six states, active row always below header, and the trailing 'No structural system is selected by template...' note fully inside the clip window at every state. SEISMIC - 5 states forward/reverse in order at 1920x1080 and 1366x768; diagram and copy window share an identical top axis (deltaTop = 0px at 1920x1080, 1440x900, 1280x800). GROUND - depth readout matched the panel at the innerHeight*0.45 reading line on all 41 samples (zero mismatches) and inter-panel gaps measured [0,0,0,0,0]px (no blank gaps). CONCRETE - all 7 cards activate [0..6] forward and [6..0] reverse, active card heading/paragraph unclipped and on-screen in X, section head and the TS EN 206 note both inside the header-to-fold safe area at 1920x1080, 1440x900 and 1280x800. EXECUTION - 5 columns [0..4] forward and reverse, nothing clipped, build-up drawing label tracked the active column. REINFORCEMENT (6) and WATERPROOFING (5) - in order forward and reverse at both viewports, trailing regulatory note fully readable at the final state. MOBILE/TABLET FALLBACK at 768x1024, 430x932, 390x844, 1024x768 - zero states dimmed below opacity 0.35, zero clipped states, zero residual pin-spacers or rail transforms, footer reached and visible. DETERMINISM - 12 scrollbar jumps (f=0.15/0.85/0.42 across 4 pinned sections) all landed on the expected canonical index with exactly one active state; resizes through 1440x900, 1280x800, 1024x768, 768x1024 and back to 1920x1080 all left the Structural section on the index matching the final scroll position with overflow=0. USEFUL TEST APPROACH for the next agent: scroll with section.offsetTop + (section.offsetHeight - innerHeight) * fraction, wait ~800-900ms before measuring expanded descriptions (the .cx-el-d max-height transition makes scrollHeight-clientHeight report false 'clipped' values of 10-95px if you sample at ~150ms - do NOT report those as bugs), and allow ~2.5s after load for the GSAP/Three.js CDN bundles.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect reproduced. The only two observations logged are (a) a 6-20px cosmetic encroachment of the hero kicker into the transparent fixed-header bounding box at <=1024px widths, which does not obscure text because the header paints no background at scrollY=0, and (b) the intentional .cx-copywin/.cx-copymove tracking translation, which by design moves non-active copy outside the clip window while guaranteeing the canonical active state and the trailing regulatory note are readable at their respective scroll positions. An earlier apparent 'description clipped by 10-95px' signal was a measurement artefact of sampling scrollHeight vs clientHeight during the CSS max-height expand transition; re-measured after an 850-900ms settle, every expanded description reported clip=0 with max-height equal to its full scrollHeight.
